info.description:
Use the EMCS API to submit excise movement notifications to the Excise Movement and Control System (EMCS). You can also send and receive messages about excise movements and retrieve information about excise traders. 

The [EMCS API service guide](/guides/emcs-api-service-guide-4-2/) contains a detailed overview of v1.0 of the API.

Testing instructions can be found in the [EMCS API testing guide](/guides/emcs-api-testing-guide-4-2/).

parameters.description:
Filter excise movements modified after provided timestamp.
This can be used to poll for any updated movements.
For each updated movement that gets returned, you can then call the get messages endpoint and pass in the same value for its "updatedSince" query parameter to get the messages that have been received since you last polled.
